title: fix(geometry): order sheet cuts before material release
body:
Stacked on #2808 (merge #2808 first)

## What changed

Add `camcraft_geometry::nesting::cut_order` for one placed sheet.
Build a global containment forest for closed loops and open chains.
Resolve closed `Auto` sides by depth parity and open `Auto` sides to `OnLine`.
Traverse the forest iteratively. Sort siblings by enclosed area, then stable ID.
Schedule marking, internal, rough profile, and final breakthrough phases.
Use an explicit `release_phase` to distinguish blind pockets from through cuts.
Refuse invalid geometry, side requests, incomplete schedules, and cuts after material release.
Report circular-tool corner limits without changing the picked geometry.

## Cause

The geometry crate lacked one cut order across a nested sheet.
An enclosing hole can free a smaller part before that part's cuts finish.

title: feat(2d): arc turns and their radius on Face, 2D Contour and Slot
body:
## What changed

Face, 2D Contour and Slot have the arc turns option with a corner arc radius. The parameters are `blend_turns` and `blend_radius`, the same as on 2D Pocket, 2D Adaptive and 2D Offset (#1733).

All three kinds can round their corners safely. No kind is left out.

- **2D Contour** had `blend_turns`. It gets `blend_radius`. No radius is the tool radius, as before.
- **Face** had `blend_turns`. It gets `blend_radius`. No radius is the semicircle of half the row spacing, as before. A smaller radius gives two quarter arcs with a straight step between them. The step is one radius outside the overrun line, away from the footprint. With a radius, rows spaced wider than the tool diameter turn on arcs too.
- **Slot** gets `blend_turns` and `blend_radius`. Each row-end corner of the serpentine pass turns on one tangent arc. No radius is the tool radius. The new module is `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_turns.rs`.

The parameter door (`sane.rs`) refuses a radius below 0.01 mm on the three kinds. The generators refuse a radius larger than the tool radius, with the text of `corner_arc_radius`. The project file writes the keys only when they are set. The cache digest reads the radius only when the option is on.

The operation pages show the radius rows when the option is on. The Face page names its default "Arc radius = half the row spacing".

MCP: `edit_operation` sets the two fields through `EditOperationParams`. No new command and no new tool are necessary.

The type is `feat`, because the change adds parameters. The task template gave `fix`.

## Cause

The fix for #1733 gave the radius to the three pocket kinds only. Face and 2D Contour had the option without a radius. Slot did not have the option.

## Which corners turn, and why no arc cuts past the wall

- 2D Contour: only a corner that turns toward the air gets an arc. This is the law of `fillet.rs`, and it did not change. A corner that turns toward the part stays sharp, and the notes name it. A convex outside corner is such a corner, so an arc cannot leave material there.
- Face: each point of a turn is on or outside the overrun line, one tool radius from the footprint. The turn reaches one radius past that line at most.
- Slot: the pass is in the cutter-center stadium, which is convex. A fillet is inside the triangle of its corner and its two tangent points, and that triangle is inside the stadium. `fillet_corners` proves each triangle again and keeps a corner sharp if it cannot prove it. An arc leaves corner rest at the round end of the slot. The note states the largest rest.

## Tests

Pins in `crates/motion/tests/arc_turn_kinds.rs` (13 tests):

title: feat(2d): rest machining on the 2D Pocket from the previous operations
body:
## What changed

The rest group of the 2D Pocket has a new mode, "previous operations".
In this mode the rest area is read from the stock that the earlier operations of the same setup leave.
The entered-tool mode of #1489 does not change, and it stays the default.

- `RestParams` has the field `source` (`RestSource::EnteredTool` or `RestSource::PreviousOperations`).
- `machining2d::rest_pocket_previous` plans the rest passes from a column grid.
  `rest_stock_from_columns` builds the `RestStock` of #2031 from that grid, one floor for each cut depth.
  `rest_plan_stock` makes the rest area from it.
- The grid is the one that `rest::prior_state` builds for the 3D Pocket: the setup stock, cut by the cached paths of the earlier operations, each with its tool shape.
- The reading is conservative:
  - A column stands at a cut depth when its top is above that depth. A floor allowance is material.
  - The standing columns grow by one cell diagonal.
  - A column that cannot be read stands. The pocket outside the grid stands.
  - The rest area is the union over all cut depths. A roughing pass that stops above the floor leaves the whole pocket.
- The two modes never use the planner of the other mode. Each planner refuses the other mode by name.
- The mode rides the existing `EditOperationParams` command (undo and redo), the project key `rest.source` and the MCP `edit_operation` parameter.
  A file without the key reads as the entered tool.
- The Pocket page has the row "Rest stock from". The previous tool rows hide in the new mode.

Generation refuses by name when the stock cannot be established:

- an earlier operation of the setup has no toolpath;
- an earlier operation of the setup has a stale toolpath;
- an earlier operation of the setup is suppressed and has a cut on record;
- the Pocket is tilted (also refused at the edit).

When no earlier operation cut, the stock is known. The whole pocket is cut and a note says it.

## Cause

The rest generator trusted the entered previous tool.
It could not see the depth that the earlier operation reached (#1490, item 3).

## Tests

Pins, all new:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest_prior_tests.rs` (lib): `each_reading_guard_is_pinned_and_its_removal_fails_the_pin`, `a_floor_cut_at_the_cut_depth_does_not_stand_and_one_above_it_does`, `bad_input_is_refused_by_name`.
- `crates/motion/tests/rest_previous.rs`: 6 tests. They compare the rest area with an independent simulation of the earlier operations: a flat tool, a wall allowance, a bull-nose tool, mixed tools with a partial depth and disconnected cuts, an island. The rest path cuts each column that was left and cuts no wall.
- `crates/app/tests/rest_previous_ops.rs`: 7 tests. The real job against an independent simulation; the shallow roughing pass; the four refusals; stale after a changed tool, depth and order; `RegenerateAll`; undo and redo; the project file; MCP with save and reopen.
- `crates/app/src/operation/rest_op_tests.rs`: `the_rest_group_moves_the_stamp` now also covers the mode.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/rest_source_tests.rs`: 2 tests for the new row.

Red before the change: the pins use the new API and do not compile on `upstream/main`. Thus the mutation results below are the proof for each guard.

Mutations (one guard removed, its pin run, then restored):

| Guard removed | Pin | Mutant | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| every cut depth is read (`Guards::depth`) | `each_reading_guard_...` | red | green |
| an unreadable column stands (`Guards::unknown`) | `each_reading_guard_...` | red | green |
| the pocket outside the grid stands (`Guards::outside`) | `each_reading_guard_...` | red | green |
| one cell of growth (`Guards::cell`) | `each_reading_guard_...` | red | green |
| `rest_plan` refuses the new mode | `the_two_rest_modes_never_use_each_others_planner` | red | green |
| `rest_pocket_previous` refuses the entered mode | same | red | green |
| `validate` does not read the previous tool in the new mode | same | red | green |
| job: tilted plane refused | `a_tilted_plane_is_refused_by_name_at_the_edit_and_at_generation` | red | green |
| door: tilted plane refused at the edit | same | red | green |
| job: `previous_ops_refusal` is called | `a_stock_that_cannot_be_established_is_refused_by_name` | red | green |
| earlier operation suppressed | same | red | green |
| earlier operation stale | same | red | green |
| earlier operation never generated | same | red | green |
| the Pocket arm routes the mode | `the_rest_pass_cuts_what_the_simulated_roughing_pass_left` | red | green |
| stamp byte 0xD8 | `the_rest_group_moves_the_stamp` | red | green |

The first four guards have a switch in the code (`rest_prior::Guards`), and the unit test turns each off. The other eleven were removed by hand.

## Review evidence on the final head

The final head is `7969769d3f98555fab3448d5936214f91cb0736f`.
The review requests evidence only. The source and the head stay unchanged.

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` is green: 237 steps, 0 failed.
The selected lanes include every motion and app heavy target.
They ran 57 motion tests and 43 app tests. Six expected-failure probes gave the expected result.
The base is `upstream/main` at `60cb97a0b3717bf6a129e781fd8f4ec98806124b`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is red: 385 steps, 1 failed, 39.8 minutes.
Only the UI library step failed: 1373 passed, 7 failed, 7 ignored.
Six `egui_app::report_tests` tests and `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` could not create a graphics adapter.
They report `CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")`.
All motion and app suites passed. All selected UI integration suites passed.

`cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

These images use the existing Pocket page test fixture.
The GPU adapter was unavailable: `CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")`.
A temporary software renderer painted the actual egui meshes and textures.
It did not recreate the controls or their text.
The temporary capture code was removed before the final quick gate.
The three images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
No image or review evidence was added to this PR branch.

Before: the renderer from `upstream/main` at `60cb97a0b` uses the PR data model.
Only the default `source` field was added for model compatibility.
The source selector is absent. The three previous-tool rows are present.

![Before: previous-tool rows without the source selector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51/pr-2822/before.png)

![After: entered-tool mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51/pr-2822/after-entered-tool.png)

After, previous-operations mode: the previous-tool rows are hidden. The rest allowance stays visible.

![After: previous-operations mode hides the previous-tool rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51/pr-2822/after-previous-operations.png)

The pin is `egui_app::rest_pocket_tests::source::the_source_row_switches_the_mode_hides_the_tool_rows_and_commits_on_apply`.
The pin failed when the entered-tool visibility guard was disabled.
It passed after the guard was restored.


## Goldens moved

None. `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl" "*.png"` is empty.

## Not exercised

- A setup whose stock is carried from an earlier setup (#318). The code path is `rest::prior_state`, which the 3D Pocket uses. No test here crosses a setup boundary. The check for stale operations reads the same setup only.
- A WCS yaw. The existing `wcs_yaw::enter` turns the grid. No test here has a yaw.
- The field stock engine (#586, #637). The reader is `Columns`, which reads the two engines. The tests use the column grid.
- Zigzag and Offset rings in the new mode. They use the passes of the entered-tool mode, which has its own tests. The new tests use Waterline.
- The pixel snapshots (release lane). The new row moves the rows of a Pocket page that has rest machining on.
- The app was not started by hand. The UI tests ran the page in the test harness.

## Known limits (recorded in `docs/decisions/2033-rest-previous-ops.md`)

- One rest area for all levels. An upper level can cut air where only a lower level has material.
- The strict reading keeps a band of about 1.5 cells along each wall that an earlier tool rode. The rest pass follows those walls.
- The Adaptive strategy stays refused. The Adaptive strategy of the 2D Pocket is retired, so `rest_adaptive` has no door from this operation.
- The MCP skill text (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`) does not describe the new `source` key. The session could not write that file. That edit is owed.
- The guide pages on the site do not describe the new mode.

## Overlaps

- #2716 changes `generate.rs`, `job.rs` and `params.rs` in other arms (the Contour kind). Different function parts. The PR that merges second refreshes.
- #2714 changes `generate.rs`, `params.rs` and `machining2d/mod.rs` for the Slot Undercut kind. Different lines. The PR that merges second refreshes.
- #2678 changes `generate.rs`, `job.rs` and `machining2d/mod.rs`. Its hunks are not in the rest branch of the Pocket arm. The PR that merges second refreshes.

title: feat(ui): stock axis choice on the Stock page (along Z, X, Y or custom)
body:
## What changed

- The Stock page has a "Stock axis" choice: Along Z (default), Along X, Along Y and Custom. Custom shows three angles in degrees: turn about Z (yaw), tilt about Y (pitch), tilt about X (roll). The choice applies to a box and to a cylinder. The old "Rotation (yaw deg)" row is replaced.
- The turn is stored in the stock's existing `Location.rot`. There is no new shape field and no project-file version step.
- Apply sends the whole turn through the undoable `SetStock` (new UI queue entry `CommandKind::SetStockPose`; the old `CommandKind::SetStock { yaw_deg }` stays for its callers). Undo restores the old turn.
- The page reads a stored turn back. A preset turn shows its preset. Any other turn shows Custom with its angles (`camcraft_geometry::geometry::stock_axis`).
- Before any simulation, the page shows a plain note when the simulation cannot cut the drafted stock: a stock tilted off the axes. Since #2758 the simulation cuts a cylinder laid along X or Y. The note asks the simulation's own law (`stock_follow::sim_frame`). The refusals `OBLIQUE_STOCK` and `LAID_CYLINDER` do not change. A box laid along X or Y is a square turn, so the simulation cuts it and no note shows.
- MCP `set_stock` takes an optional `axis` ("z", "x", "y") or `angles_deg` ({yaw, pitch, roll}), not both. It calls the same `SetStock` and returns `{ stock, axis, angles_deg }`. The camcraft-mcp skill row is updated.
- `sketch.rs`: the DXF profile face ignored the stock's turn. Now an upright stock keeps its top face, a stock laid square is read as the same solid unturned, and a laid cylinder or a tilted stock is refused by name (`sketch::NO_TOP_FACE`). `ImportDxf` shows that refusal.
- Decision: `docs/decisions/2576-stock-axis.md`.
- Follow-up: #2758 (stock simulation: cut a cylinder or box stock that lies along X or Y).

Process change: yes

## Readings

- X preset = a quarter turn about Y (stock Z goes to world +X). Y preset = a minus quarter turn about X (stock Z goes to world +Y).
- A laid 50 x 40 x 20 box at (3, 4, 5): the profile face is at the highest Z of the turned box, and its normal is world +Z (pinned).

## Pinning tests

title: feat(2d): Slot Undercut for T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop cutters
body:
## What changed

This PR adds the Slot Undercut operation and the cutters for it.

- **Four cutter kinds** in `camcraft-tools`: `t_slot`, `keyseat`, `dovetail`, `lollipop`. They use the existing tool fields. `diameter` is the head. `flute_len` is the head height. `shank_d` and `shank_len` are the neck. `tip_angle` is the dovetail flank angle. The kind words are additive, so `PROJECT_VERSION` does not change. The starter catalog has one cutter of each kind.
- **One generator** in `camcraft-motion` (`machining2d::undercut`). It cuts a straight slot or a circular slot (DXF-style bulge). It changes Z at one XY station only, outside the wall. It feeds in sideways, cuts the centre pass and the radial stepover passes at one depth, feeds out the same way, then lifts. The pass offset comes from the widest point of the cutter profile, not from the tip.
- **One verify law** in `camcraft-sim` (`Mode::Undercut`, `verify/undercut.rs`). A move that changes Z while material is in or over the head is `Warning::UndercutLift`. It blocks the post. A neck or holder band with material above its bottom is a `ShankHit`. The operation layer reads the two again against the stock that the earlier operations left (`acquit_undercut_by_prior`). A neck slot that an earlier Slot operation cut is then air.
- **The true profile in the solid law.** The solid law judges a dovetail as a frustum and a lollipop as a full ball (`Prof::Dove`, `Prof::Ball`). The head top gets the same allowance as the tip, so a head that stands under its roof is contact and not a gouge.
- **The true profile in the field stock simulation** (`Stock::simulate_undercut`, `Stock::with_partial_undercut`, `SdfTool::Dovetail`). The head and the neck are two convex solids. The field keeps their union. Both the stock view and Simulate playback cut the head and neck with it. Notice `cut_twin_work::twin_tool` maps `SdfTool::Dovetail` to `"dovetail"`.
- **The column engines cut nothing for an undercut.** A column has one top for each (x, y). It cannot hold air below material.
- **App**: `OpParams::SlotUndercut` (kind tag 44, appended), the project file mirror (keeping `0.0` `bulge` and `neck_slot` keys in JSON), the stamp digest, heights, the part solid law for a part source, and the kept-parts law for both stock and part sources.
- **MCP**: `add_operation` with kind `Slot Undercut` (key `slot_undercut`) and `add_tool` with the new kind words. `verify` reports the new finding kind `undercut_lift`. `list_operation_types` and `edit_operation` include `bulge` and `neck_slot` when they equal `0.0`.
- **UI**: the four undercut kinds in the tool editor (`tool_undercut_row.rs` seeds valid defaults, `Flank angle (deg)` / `flank angle °` edits `ToolKind::Dovetail`, and `Corner radius` stays hidden for undercut kinds), the Slot Undercut page (`undercut_page.rs`), and five original icons (SVG masters rendered with `cargo xtask icons`).
- **Docs**: a Slot Undercut section in the 2D operations guide, and `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md`.

## UI screenshots

Before/after renders from the headless `ShellUi` (`1440x960` WGPU) on `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`) and this PR branch (images stored on `mkinney/Camcraft` `pr-screenshots` commit `0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86`):

| View | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Tool editor (`DT-20-60` dovetail cutter) | ![Tool editor before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/tool-editor-before.png) | ![Tool editor after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/tool-editor-after.png) |
| Slot Undercut page (`TSlot` in milling setup) | ![Slot Undercut before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/slot-undercut-before.png) | ![Slot Undercut after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/slot-undercut-after.png) |

## Cause

There was no cutter kind with a head wider than its neck, and no operation for one. The laws for a plain contour are wrong below a roof. The column model reads a pass as a cleared kerf, so a lift through the roof passes as a retract in its own kerf.

## Tests

New pins cover the new behaviour. Each review fix below also has a direct test and mutation check.

- `camcraft-tools --lib` (`107 passed; 0 failed`): `undercut::tests` checks sane cutters, refusals by name, the profile contact point, and the drawn outline.
- `camcraft-motion --lib` (`459 passed; 0 failed; 10 ignored`): `machining2d::undercut::tests` pins single-station Z moves, entry slot refusals, concentric arc slots, profile contact offsets, and input refusals.
- `camcraft-sim --test undercut_laws` (`14 passed; 0 failed`): pins `UndercutLift`, `ShankHit`, `acquit_undercut_by_prior`, `Prof::Dove`, `Prof::Ball`, `Atom::cap`, and `Stock::simulate_undercut`.
- `camcraft-app --test mcp_slot_undercut` (`7 passed; 0 failed`): pins MCP cutting, verification, posting, refusals, `a_part_source_undercut_keeps_neighbouring_parts`, and `list_operation_types_and_edit_operation_keep_zero_bulge_and_neck_slot`.
- `camcraft-app --test stock_play` (`8 passed; 0 failed`): pins `playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view`.
- `camcraft-app --test stock_play_partial` (`4 passed; 0 failed`): pins `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy`.
- `camcraft-motion --test golden_undercut`: pins four golden CL files. The generator suite and its unchanged goldens now live in `crates/motion/tests/`.
- `camcraft-app --test tool_law` (`5 passed; 0 failed`): pins undercut cutter compatibility.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (`1256 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored`): includes `tool_undercut_row::tests`, `tool_cutter_params::each_milling_kind_shows_the_parameters_its_outline_is_drawn_from`, and `tests/tool_undercut.rs` (`new_tool_undercut_kinds_seed_sane_defaults_hide_corner_radius_and_show_dovetail_flank_angle`, `dovetail_properties_and_editor_edit_flank_angle_without_corner_radius`, and `slot_undercut_page_shows_its_geometry_heights_passes_and_feeds_fields`).

Review-fix mutation checks (guard reverted -> RED, restored -> GREEN):

- UI dovetail flank angle, undercut defaults, and corner-radius filter reverted: RED (`3 failed` across `tests/tool_undercut.rs` and `tool_cutter_params`). Restored: GREEN (`11 passed; 0 failed`).
- `is_part_kept_kind` reverted in `crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs`: `a_part_source_undercut_keeps_neighbouring_parts` RED (`post` succeeded instead of refusing). Restored: GREEN (`7 passed; 0 failed`).
- `skip_serializing_if = "is_zero"` restored in `crates/app/src/project/undercut_dto.rs`: `list_operation_types_and_edit_operation_keep_zero_bulge_and_neck_slot` RED (`list_operation_types` omitted `bulge` and `neck_slot`). Restored: GREEN (`7 passed; 0 failed`).
- `stock_play.rs` and `stock_play_head.rs` undercut playback handling reverted: `playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view` and `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy` RED. Restoring `stock_play.rs` alone kept `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy` RED. Restored both: GREEN (`8 passed; 0 failed` and `4 passed; 0 failed`).

Gate on `b95c27b2e52fc8b976ce9372bcc5e4141c247113`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 651 steps with zero failures (45.9 minutes). The merged main revision is `e5b0ca3c1`. It includes #2767, which fixes the four reviewed area-preview failures. The UI unit suite passed 1,258 tests (7 ignored). All 16 UI integration suites passed. `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with zero warnings.

Latest review-fix checks:

- The motion `golden_undercut` suite passed all four tests. Removing the motion test target gave RED. A feed change from 120 to 121 made all four goldens fail. Restoring the suite and feed returned all four tests to GREEN. The four CL files moved without byte changes.
- Reverting the main geometry fix gave exactly the four reviewed frame-cost failures. Restoring it returned all eight frame-cost tests to GREEN.
- The temporary literature audit gave RED on the old decision (0/8 checks) and GREEN on the updated decision (8/8). The decision records checked sources, design choices, and limitations. No audit script or review evidence is on this branch.

Current review-fix status: `upstream/main` at `a35c9cb81` merged cleanly into this branch. The merge includes catalog-hint correction `3f945362a`. Equal-size candidates use the tool name to break a tie. `the_refusal_names_a_fitting_catalog_entry` and `a_size_tie_picks_by_name_not_file_order` pin the result. The `tool_gate` suite passed all 10 tests. Removing the name tie-breaker gave RED in both pins; restoration returned GREEN. All 852 quick-gate steps passed across two runs. An app build-cache error interrupted the first run. Cleaning ignored build artifacts and rebuilding resolved it; the app/UI retry passed all 646 steps, including `tool_gate`. Clippy: passed with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`. Head: `c9410977ae2c22ff48e18596563c5b250d6d2690`.

## Goldens moved

No existing golden changed. Four golden CL files are new:

- `slot_undercut_tslot_straight.cl`
- `slot_undercut_keyseat_arc.cl`
- `slot_undercut_dovetail_straight.cl`
- `slot_undercut_lollipop_arc.cl`

No snapshot PNG changed. Five icon PNGs are new (`cargo xtask icons` wrote them from the new SVG masters and changed no other PNG).

## Not exercised

- The literature search ran during the latest review fix. `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md` records checked handbook, Autodesk behaviour, and research sources for entry, exit, profiles, and field simulation. It records the limits of those sources and the implementation. The search used the web tool because Perplexity was unavailable. The implementation preceded this search.
- Dovetail and lollipop parts are not tested through the app. Their profiles are tested in the sim crate (solid law and field stock) and the generator.
- The program verdict before a post reads the stock from above. It does not show the undercut as removed. The undercut law and the solid law judge the operation instead.
- A flipped WCS and a rotated work offset refuse the kind. An aligned setup and a WCS yaw do not list it. No 3+2 tilt.
- One depth level for each operation. The far end of a blind slot stays square. The centre line is typed, not picked.
- Issue #896 (form cutters with a drawn outline, corner rounding, slitting saw) stays open. This PR adds only the four parametric kinds that #1444 needs.

## Overlaps

No open PR changes the same function. These open PRs change other functions in the same files. The PR that merges second refreshes.

- #2678, #2149: `mcp/job.rs`, `operation/generate.rs`, `project/file.rs`, `verify/mod.rs`, `verify/probe.rs`, `verify/types.rs`, `ui/state.rs`
- #2675, #2666: `operation/generate.rs`

- #2665, #2662, #1798: `ui/state.rs` (#1798 also `icons.rs`)

#2670, #2563, #1713, #1798, #2665, #2712, #2715, #2730, #2731, #2741, and #2742 merged while this work ran. Their changes are in the branch through the merge of `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`).

title: ci(release): run the site tests in the site job
body:
## What changed

PR #1825 added `site/tests/test_operation_reference.py`. It pins the 44 operation pictures against the `OpType` enum. Nothing ran it. The four other site tests that build the site with Zola had the same problem.

- `.github/workflows/release.yml`, job `site`: a new step `Site tests`, after `Install pinned Zola` and before `Version the site is built from`. It runs `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v` with `ZOLA: /tmp/zola` (the pinned v0.23.6 that the job already installs and checks).
  - It runs the full site suite, not only the operation reference file. This is the command that `site/README.md` already gives, and all 61 tests pass. Thus the guide navigation, image, icon and troubleshooting tests also get a run. Dropped option: one file only (`test_operation_reference.py`), which leaves the other Zola tests with no run.
  - It runs before `version.toml` exists, on the same tree as a local run.
  - No `continue-on-error`: a red site test fails the `site` job, and thus `pages` does not deploy.
- `site/README.md`: one paragraph says that the release runs the same command, and how the tests find Zola.
- No trigger, permission, runner or other job changes. `python3` is on `ubuntu-latest`.

## Tests

Pinned by `the_site_job_runs_the_site_tests_with_its_pinned_zola` (new file `xtask/tests/release_site_tests.rs`, in the same form as `xtask/tests/post_merge_concurrency.rs`). It reads the `site` job and asserts:
- the `Site tests` step comes after `Install pinned Zola`;
- it runs `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v`;
- it sets `ZOLA: /tmp/zola`;
- it has no `continue-on-error`.

Without the workflow step, the test fails with `the site job runs the site tests (#1832)`.

Readings (Linux, the pinned Zola v0.23.6, sha256 checked):
- `ZOLA=<pinned zola> python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 61 tests, OK, 11 s.
- With one picture line removed from `operations-2d.md` (`operation-paths.svg#Slot`): the suite fails, with `Slot needs its toolpath picture` among the failures. The file was restored.
- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): `xtask unit tests` ok (the new test ran and passed).
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The workflow YAML parses (`yaml.safe_load`); the site steps start `Install pinned Zola`, `Site tests`, `Version the site is built from`.

## Not exercised

- No real `release.yml` run. The next cut (or a `workflow_dispatch` run) is the full check.
- `actionlint` is not installed on this machine.

## Notes

- The issue says that the Zola part of the test is "skippable when the binary is absent, as today". It is not: without Zola, the five Zola tests error (`FileNotFoundError`), they do not skip. This PR does not change that, because the job always has Zola. The README now says so.
- A `.github/` change from a fork: read, not built. It waits for the maintainer (`needs-maintainer`).
- `xtask/` is a process file (the new test). The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. A fork needs no action.
- Branch base: `upstream/main`. No context scout ran; this session did its own searches.

Process change: yes
Changelog: none
Effort: low

Fixes #1832
